name: dsh-screenshot
description: Screenshots that are worth publishing: four tools that capture a page (loopback dev server, workspace file, or a public site with `remote: true`), an application window and the screen on Windows, and place the pictures in a repository at a deterministic name and a correct display width with the README ``/`` block and its alt text. Host-only, zero npm dependencies, no bundled engine (the machine's own Chrome/Edge, its own PowerShell and GDI+), no git and no credential.
